Bloomberg: "Iran Attacks Kuwait Desalination and Power Plants as Hostilities Worsen"
https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-17/iran-attacks-kuwait-desalination-and-power-plants-as-hostilities-worsen
Snippet: Kuwait's government said on Friday a desalination and electricity plant was hit, with many power-generation units sustaining damage. Iran attacked Kuwaiti water and power plants in counterstrikes against the US. Kuwait's General Staff said the country's air defence systems were intercepting missile attacks and hostile drones following what it described as ongoing Iranian aggression.

Kuwaiti army statement (via search snippet, 18 July 2026): "Kuwaiti air defenses are currently confronting attacks by hostile drones, following the sinful Iranian aggression."

Kuwaiti military (snippet): Iran targeted army facilities and military camps with drones, injuring a number of Kuwaiti Land Forces personnel while they were carrying out their duties; all those injured in a "stable" condition. Officials did not reveal the exact number injured.

IRGC (snippet): announced execution of the "15th wave of Operation Nasr 2", claiming missile and drone strikes hit several US troop deployment sites plus launch pads and HIMARS systems in Kuwait.

Context (snippet): One projectile in June hit the passenger terminal at Kuwait's civilian airport, killing one person and injuring more than 60.
